description:
Cast Spawn-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Ulalek and Spawn-Gang Commander trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, then Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Once you have infinite {C} and Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to Spawn-Gang Commander to deal infinite damage to any target(s), and you may resolve all copies of the Spawn-Gang Commander spell.
